verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an AI creative platform with an API and agents. However, nothing in the evidence documents rules, triggers, or event-driven actions. Luma Skills ('Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever') and Luma Agents describe reusable, multi-step workflows. They are not documented as firing automatically on events, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
